primary_source_unavailable.selection_encryption: ElectionGuard 2.1 publishes the parameter constants but no worked encryption vector with a fixed nonce that could be reproduced byte-for-byte; the specification gives the equations, not examples
primary_source_unavailable.selection_proof: no published disjunctive Chaum-Pedersen transcript with fixed randomness; and EPD2's Fiat-Shamir context is EPD2-specific, so an ElectionGuard transcript would not apply unchanged in any case
primary_source_unavailable.ballot_hash: EPD2 uses its own canonical encoding (EPD2-ENC-1) and domain separation registry, so a ballot digest is by construction an EPD2 value with no external counterpart
primary_source_unavailable.confirmation_code: the confirmation-code alphabet and grouping are EPD2 decisions from PACK-16C, not ElectionGuard ones
primary_source_unavailable.accumulation: componentwise multiplication has no published vector; it is checked cross-implementation instead
primary_source_unavailable.threshold_tally: no published end-to-end threshold tally vector on the standard parameters was located

vectors.source_title: ElectionGuard Design Specification v2.1.0, section 3.1.1 page 14
vectors.source_digest: a263ab3cd2cf28f05de324ecd2d9752ffed45f814709582b4c2bb23d1826b936 (inherited from PACK-16B evidence F-01, first-hand there, NOT re-verified this round)
vectors.canonical_input: p, q, g, r as published
vectors.comparison_result: MATCH - and established independently of any source: p reconstructs offline from the published ln 2 rule plus the recorded 279-bit delta, q = 2^256-189 in closed form, r = (p-1)/q, g = 2^r mod p. Also q | p-1, 1 < g < p, g^q = 1 mod p, and p, q and r/2 probable prime.
vectors.limitations: The corroborating upstream Rust file is NOT commit-pinned and its byte-exact digest is NOT recorded: github.com, api.github.com and CDN mirrors are all blocked by this environment's egress proxy (HTTP 403). An earlier digest computed over a markdown rendering has been WITHDRAWN rather than relabelled (OD-P16D-17). The specification PDF's own digest is inherited from PACK-16B and was not re-verified here. VO-08 remains OPEN: having the published constants is not having an assessment that they are appropriate.

vectors.source_title: RFC 8032, Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA), section 7.1
vectors.source_digest: n/a — vector reproduced verbatim in test_checkpoint_signatures.py
vectors.canonical_input: RFC 8032 section 7.1 TEST 1 (empty message), TEST 2 (one byte), TEST 3 (two bytes) - secret key, public key, message, signature
vectors.comparison_result: MATCH - all three vectors reproduce exactly against the vetted provider: derived public key, produced signature, and verification
vectors.limitations: Three of the RFC's vectors are reproduced, not all of them. The RFC's longer messages and the Ed25519ph variant are not covered.

vectors.source_title: OpenSSL command-line tool (`openssl pkeyutl -verify`)
vectors.source_digest: n/a — live comparison, not a stored vector
vectors.canonical_input: 6 cases: the 3 RFC 8032 vectors, each valid and each with a mutated message
vectors.comparison_result: 6 cases: 3 RFC 8032 vectors accepted, 3 mutated-message variants rejected. The empty-message vector is reported skipped by the tool and is covered by the RFC vector test instead.
vectors.limitations: The CLI binary and the library the active provider links share an upstream project, so a defect present in both would be invisible here. The evidence that does not share a lineage is the RFC 8032 published vectors.

classification_note: Five classes. `cross-implementation` was split by profile because a single label made it invisible that most checks ran on the 1024-bit test group; `rfc-conformance` was split from `primary-source` because an RFC's published vectors are the strongest evidence a primitive can have and belong in their own count. `internal-stability` is not external evidence and is counted here as zero on purpose: those 23 vectors live in PACK-16D-TEST-VECTORS.json and are never promoted into this catalogue.
